street_gutter.title: The gutter
street_gutter.speaker: protagonist
street_gutter.text: Water stands in the gutter and runs towards a drain set higher up the road. The water does not look like it is in a hurry.
street_gutter.repeat_text: The same standing water, still going uphill.

record.text: The water in the street gutter runs towards a drain that sits higher than it.

street_shutter.title: The shutter
street_shutter.speaker: protagonist
street_shutter.text: A shop shutter pulled down and padlocked at the bottom. The sign above it has been painted over twice. The second colour is still wet.
street_shutter.repeat_text: Shutter down, padlock on, the second coat still wet.

record.text: A closed shop on the street has a sign painted over twice; the top coat is still wet.

street_bin.title: The bins
street_bin.speaker: protagonist
street_bin.text: Two bins. One has been emptied and one has not, and both lids carry the same collection day.
street_bin.repeat_text: One emptied, one not, the same day on both lids.

street_lamp.title: The street lamp
street_lamp.speaker: protagonist
street_lamp.text: The lamp is already on, though the sky is still bright enough to read by. A moth is working at it the way moths do.
street_lamp.repeat_text: Lamp on, sky bright, moth still at it.
